title: Juicy Tender American Chicken Stew
description: A hearty one-pot American dish featuring tender chicken, garlicky flavors, and sweet cranberries, all made with Whole30-friendly ingredients and a hint of dashi extract.

ingredients.name: dashi extract
ingredients.notes: make sure it is Whole30 compliant

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.notes: make sure it is Whole30 compliant

instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set it aside.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cranberries, dashi extract, chicken broth, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
